worlds.name: synthetic_object_naming
worlds.latent_description: Each page shows a different synthetic object type and its repeated letter is stipulated to name that type; the token swap generator is unchanged.

worlds.name: mechanical_copy_without_object_names
worlds.latent_description: The scribe mechanically copies a nearby repeated marker; latent object types are assigned independently and do not supply these strings as names. The token swap generator is identical.

proof: For any statistic or decision f using only the observed strings and fixed metadata X, identical X implies identical f(X). Defining the same generator for X under both latent explanations yields identical distributions. Rejection of an artificial uniform-pairing null cannot select either latent explanation.
qualification: Constructed counterexample, not historical evidence that either process produced the Voynich manuscript; no new image/object truth, language meaning or translation; one shared observable record, not two independent experiments.
copy_calibration_binding: Will separately bind the real-background synthetic swap outputs after B completes; this file is only the predeclared toy witness.
